hunks.baseline: I was flying through the sky. Enormous wings spread, I cut through the wind.
hunks.sol: I was flying through the sky, enormous wings spread wide as I cut through the wind.

hunks.baseline: Far below, a high, steep gorge came into view. Shaped like a bottle gourd, it held people—hundreds of them, at a rough count.
hunks.sol: Far below lay a high, steep gorge shaped like a bottle gourd. Hundreds of people stood inside it.

hunks.baseline: A man standing at the center shouted at the top of his lungs.
hunks.sol: A man at their center shouted at the top of his lungs.

hunks.baseline: I glanced over my shoulder. A huge cloud of dust was sweeping through the gorge toward us.
hunks.sol: I glanced over my shoulder. An enormous cloud of dust was sweeping through the gorge toward us.

hunks.baseline: “Fight for yourselves! Fight for the flesh and blood and loved ones who will be trampled by the enemy!”
hunks.sol: “Fight for yourselves! Fight for your family and loved ones, who will be trampled by the enemy!”

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of weapons were drawn in unison. The man strode forward and took the lead. The cloud of dust crossing the gorge scattered, revealing countless people.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of weapons were drawn in unison. The man strode forward and took his place at the front. The cloud of dust rolling through the gorge scattered, revealing countless people.

hunks.baseline: “Pwah, pwah-pwah!”
hunks.sol: “Blub, blub-blub!”

hunks.baseline: I flailed desperately with my wings—or rather, my arms—before it hit me.
hunks.sol: I flailed desperately with my wings—or rather, my arms—before realizing what had happened.

hunks.baseline: Thank god. I thought I was a goner. Only after catching my breath did the situation in the room come into focus.
hunks.sol: Thank God. I thought I was a goner. Only after catching my breath did I take in the situation inside the room.

hunks.baseline: He tossed out the line with zero soul and slurped up his noodles, looking completely at home. For a moment I wondered if this was even my room.
hunks.sol: He delivered the line without a trace of sincerity, then slurped up his noodles as if he owned the place. For a moment, I wondered if this was even my room.

hunks.baseline: “What, has it only been a day or two?”
hunks.sol: “Is this anything new?”

hunks.baseline: That actually sounded plausible. I almost bought it.
hunks.sol: That sounded surprisingly reasonable. I almost bought it.

hunks.baseline: “Turn the TV off or something. People are sleeping.”
hunks.sol: “Turn the TV off or something. People are trying to sleep.”

hunks.baseline: “Some inconsiderate bastard even hits people in the uvula while they’re sleeping.”
hunks.sol: “Some inconsiderate bastard even hits a guy in the Adam’s apple while he’s sleeping.”

hunks.baseline: Anyway, that bastard had one hell of a mouth on him.
hunks.sol: No one could beat that bastard in an argument.

hunks.baseline: “If you’ve got nothing to say, eat some ramen. I boiled five packs because I thought you might wake up.”
hunks.sol: “If you’ve got nothing to say, eat some ramen. I cooked five packs because I thought you might wake up.”

hunks.baseline: Talk about foresight. I took the chopsticks from him, a wave of feeling hitting me.
hunks.sol: Talk about foresight. Overcome with emotion, I accepted the chopsticks.

hunks.baseline: Was this ordinary ramen? This was ramen I was eating for the first time in a month.
hunks.sol: Was this ordinary ramen? This was my first ramen in a month.

hunks.baseline: The smell that pulled at my appetite. Noodles cooked just right. Broth boiled spicy with separately sliced Cheongyang peppers.
hunks.sol: The mouthwatering smell, the perfectly cooked noodles, the spicy broth loaded with freshly sliced Cheongyang chili peppers…

hunks.baseline: *Insane. This is insane.*
hunks.sol: *This is insane. Absolutely insane.*

hunks.baseline: By the time I came to, it was all over. Jinho hyung stared blankly at me as I licked the pot clean.
hunks.sol: By the time I came to my senses, it was all over. Jinho hyung stared blankly as I licked the pot clean.

hunks.baseline: “I thought you were filming a commercial. Have you never eaten ramen in your life?”
hunks.sol: “I thought you were filming a commercial. Have you never eaten ramen before?”

hunks.baseline: “Are you still on that?”
hunks.sol: “You’re still going on about that?”

hunks.baseline: “Try eating nothing but Chinese food for a month, then have some ramen. Michelin’s got nothing on this.”
hunks.sol: “Try eating nothing but Chinese food for a month, then have some ramen. This deserves a Michelin star.”

hunks.baseline: He looked thoroughly fed up. But this time, I had something to back me up.
hunks.sol: He looked thoroughly fed up. This time, though, I had something to back me up.

hunks.baseline: “Look this over, then we’ll talk again.”
hunks.sol: “Look this over, then we’ll talk.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t tell me…”
hunks.sol: “Wait, is this…”

hunks.baseline: “You stuck this in a piece of junk more than twenty years old before throwing it away?”
hunks.sol: “Who throws out a piece of junk more than twenty years old with the manual still inside?”

hunks.baseline: I’d thought the same thing at first. At first.
hunks.sol: I’d thought the same thing at first.
At first.

hunks.baseline: “No, never mind—that’s still just a guess. What about the rest? The model name and manufacturer listed there. Have you heard of them?”
hunks.sol: “No, never mind. That’s still just a guess. What about the rest? Have you ever heard of the model or manufacturer listed there?”

hunks.baseline: On the related sites, he was a named user people recognized on sight. He’d even run an IT blog.
hunks.sol: He was a big name on all the related forums and had even run an IT blog.

hunks.baseline: But the answer that came out immediately sent my expectations crashing down.
hunks.sol: But his immediate answer sent my expectations crashing down.

hunks.baseline: Well, that was only natural. Even an internet search hadn’t turned anything up. Still, I couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed.
hunks.sol: Well, that was only natural. Even an internet search hadn’t turned up anything. Still, I couldn’t help feeling a little disappointed.

hunks.baseline: “An illegally modded capsule? Or a custom job? Honestly, I’ve never seen a design like that.”
hunks.sol: “An illegally modified capsule? Or maybe a custom job? Honestly, I’ve never seen a design like that.”

hunks.baseline: The more he talked, the bleaker it got.
hunks.sol: The more he talked, the bleaker things looked.

hunks.baseline: “Fine, I’ll grant you the design. But I know every model from the earliest ones to the latest. Everything that’s ever been released in Korea.”
hunks.sol: “Fine, set the design aside. But I know every model from the earliest ones to the latest. Every capsule ever released in Korea.”

hunks.baseline: “The model name written here. The manufacturer. Complete strangers.”
hunks.sol: “The model name written here. The manufacturer. I’ve never seen either one before.”

hunks.baseline: “Couldn’t it be an overseas manufacturer?”
hunks.sol: “Couldn’t it be from an overseas manufacturer?”

hunks.baseline: Jinho hyung thrust the manual at me, looking thoroughly exasperated.
hunks.sol: Looking thoroughly exasperated, Jinho hyung thrust the manual at me.

hunks.baseline: “Whether H Soft is a domestic manufacturer or an overseas one, if they went as far as making the user manual in Korean, there’s no way I wouldn’t know them. It’s not like there are hundreds or thousands of capsule manufacturers in this business.”
hunks.sol: “Whether H Soft is a domestic manufacturer or an overseas one, if they went as far as producing a Korean user manual, there’s no way I wouldn’t know them. It’s not like there are hundreds or thousands of capsule manufacturers in this business.”

hunks.baseline: I felt like a complete idiot. Not that I knew anything about capsules. That was when Jinho hyung spoke up.
hunks.sol: I felt like a complete idiot. Then again, it wasn’t like I knew anything about capsules.
Jinho hyung suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: He pulled out his smartphone and started tapping the screen. Searching, from the looks of it. But the result was obvious.
hunks.sol: He pulled out his smartphone and started tapping the screen. He seemed to be searching, but the result was obvious.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. All that comes up is porn sites.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. Nothing but a porn site.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s not even a ghost company. Why isn’t anything coming up?”
hunks.sol: “What, is it a ghost company? Why isn’t anything coming up?”

hunks.baseline: “Read the rest of it, too.”
hunks.sol: “Read the rest, too.”

hunks.baseline: By the time he reached the last page, he’d really feel like he’d been haunted. Jinho hyung turned the pages with a serious expression.
hunks.sol: By the time he reached the last page, he’d really feel like he’d seen a ghost. Jinho hyung turned the pages with a serious expression.

hunks.baseline: “Well, well. Look at this humanities-major bastard, acting all innocent.”
hunks.sol: “Well, well. Look at this liberal-arts dumbass playing innocent.”

hunks.baseline: I snatched the manual and read it in a hurry. The contents I’d seen before falling asleep were still there. Precautions on the second page. Key features on the last.
hunks.sol: I snatched the manual from him and hurriedly read it. Everything I’d seen before falling asleep was still there. Precautions on the second page. Key features on the last.
That look. That tone.
He meant it.

hunks.baseline: That look. That tone. He meant it. The writing I could see was invisible to Jinho hyung.
hunks.sol: The writing I could see was invisible to Jinho hyung.

hunks.baseline: *Only I can see this.*
hunks.sol: *Only I can see it.*

hunks.baseline: I stayed frozen like that for a long while.
hunks.sol: I stood frozen for a long time.

hunks.baseline: I climbed out of the capsule on shaky legs. Glossy exterior, shaped like a giant egg—this was the latest model, released only last month.
hunks.sol: I climbed out of the capsule on shaky legs. Its glossy exterior made it look like a giant egg. This was the latest model, released only last month.

hunks.baseline: Still half out of my mind, I answered the capsule café owner at the counter.
hunks.sol: Still half out of my mind, I answered the capsule café owner sitting behind the counter.

hunks.baseline: The virtual-reality game he’d recommended was a megahit with ten million concurrent users. Incredible graphics, outstanding freedom, over seventy percent of the market, he’d said.
hunks.sol: The virtual-reality game he’d recommended was a megahit with ten million concurrent players. It had incredible graphics, outstanding freedom, and more than seventy percent of the market, he’d said.

hunks.baseline: I logged in. I looked at the graphics and thought:
hunks.sol: I logged into the game. Then I saw the graphics and thought:

hunks.baseline: *Am I the one who’s insane?*
hunks.sol: *Am I insane?*

hunks.baseline: The NPCs’ faces and movements, their dialogue patterns, the five senses I felt through my character—all of it was unnatural. It was a *game*, but it never felt like *reality*.
hunks.sol: The NPCs’ appearances and movements, their dialogue patterns, the five senses I experienced through my character—all of it felt unnatural. It was a *game*, but it never felt like *reality*.

hunks.baseline: “No. It’s an open-world game. One you play alone.”
hunks.sol: “No. It’s an open-world game. Single-player.”

hunks.baseline: “Are there games like that in the wuxia genre?”
hunks.sol: “Is there a wuxia game like that?”

hunks.baseline: “Just. I wanted to hear your voice.”
hunks.sol: “Just because. I wanted to hear your voice.”
Silence.

hunks.baseline: A deathly silence followed.
hunks.sol: Dead silence.

hunks.baseline: “Three seconds. What’s your business.”
hunks.sol: “Three seconds. What do you want?”

hunks.baseline: Right. This was Jin Hayeon. Thanks to her, the tear ducts that had gotten a little moist dried out like sand around the pyramids.
hunks.sol: Right. This was Jin Hayeon. Any tears welling in my eyes instantly dried up like sand around the pyramids.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t. On purpose. Even this brat’s voice was enough to choke me up. If I heard Mom’s, I’d bawl like a little kid.
hunks.sol: I deliberately didn’t. Even this brat’s voice was enough to choke me up. If I heard Mom’s, I’d probably bawl like a little kid.

hunks.baseline: “I bombed the July mock exam. I didn’t manage my condition right and missed even the easy questions. God, the more I think about it, the more annoyed I get.”
hunks.sol: “I bombed the July mock exam. I was off my game and got even the easy questions wrong. God, the more I think about it, the more annoyed I get.”

hunks.baseline: I knew she was good at studying, but I hadn’t realized she was this good. Thinking back on my own school grades, it really seemed like there was such a thing as dumping all the genes into one kid.
hunks.sol: I knew she was good at studying, but I hadn’t realized she was this good. Thinking back on my own grades, it really seemed possible for one child to hog all the good genes.

hunks.baseline: “You study pretty well, huh?”
hunks.sol: “You’re pretty good at studying, huh?”

hunks.baseline: “From an older brother’s standpoint, isn’t it amazing?”
hunks.sol: “From your perspective, isn’t that amazing?”

hunks.baseline: “W-what kind of nonsense is that? I studied pretty well too, you know? You just don’t remember because you were in elementary school…”
hunks.sol: “W-what kind of nonsense is that? I was pretty good at studying too, you know. You just don’t remember because you were in elementary school…”

hunks.baseline: “Last week during a deep clean, I found your report card. There were so many Grade 7s I thought it was a slot machine that had hit the jackpot.”
hunks.sol: “Last week, while we were deep-cleaning, I found your report card. There were so many sevens, I thought it was a slot machine hitting the jackpot.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “You need some allowance, right? How much do cosmetics cost these days?”
hunks.sol: “You need some allowance, right? How much does makeup cost these days?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s pathetic. Seriously.”
hunks.sol: “That’s just sad. Seriously.”

hunks.baseline: The call lasted more than ten minutes. I did most of the listening. Hayeon rattled on about studying, school, and a boy she was interested in, and her voice was much brighter than it had been at first.
hunks.sol: The call lasted more than ten minutes. I mostly listened. Hayeon rattled on about studying, school, and a boy she was interested in, her voice much brighter than it had been at first.

hunks.baseline: I found myself getting oddly sentimental.
hunks.sol: A strange sense of sentimentality came over me.

hunks.baseline: Had I been dreaming? Or lost in a delusion?
hunks.sol: Had I been dreaming? Or had I lost myself in some delusion?

hunks.baseline: Only a day had passed in reality, yet utterly incomprehensible, inexplicable things had happened.
hunks.sol: Only a day had passed in reality, yet utterly incomprehensible things had happened to me.

hunks.baseline: But I decided not to try to understand them anymore.
hunks.sol: But I decided to stop trying to understand them.

hunks.baseline: My family was here. I was here. That was enough. I had simply dreamed a strange dream for a little while. The kind of dream that would fade on its own with time.
hunks.sol: My family was here. I was here. That was enough. I’d simply had a strange dream for a little while—the kind that would fade from memory with time.

hunks.baseline: Listening to my little sister chatter, I stood up. It was time to leave the old, rusted sign behind and go back to my room.
hunks.sol: Listening to my little sister chatter, I stood. It was time to step out from beneath the old, rusted sign and head back to my room.

hunks.baseline: Seong Jinho cracked his bleary eyes open. The smartphone by his pillow was ringing.
hunks.sol: Seong Jinho cracked his bleary eyes open. The smartphone beside his pillow was vibrating.

hunks.baseline: Six in the morning. The signal that started the day.
hunks.sol: Six in the morning. The signal that started his day.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, I’m dying.”
hunks.sol: “Oh man, I feel like death.”

hunks.baseline: It had been five years since he left home. The moldy smell that crept into his nose every morning had gotten pretty familiar. Eyes half shut, Seong Jinho shoved his cigarettes and lighter into his pocket and left the room.
hunks.sol: It had been five years since he’d left home. By now, the moldy smell that crept into his nose every morning had become thoroughly familiar. Eyes half shut, Seong Jinho shoved his cigarettes and lighter into his pocket and left the room.

hunks.baseline: He shuffled up to the rooftop in his slippers. He’d just put a cigarette between his lips when—
hunks.sol: He shuffled up to the rooftop in his slippers. He had just put a cigarette between his lips when—
What was that?

hunks.baseline: What was that? Wondering, he leaned over the railing, and a hunk of metal sitting in the recycling area right in front of him caught his eye.
hunks.sol: He leaned over the railing and spotted a hunk of metal in the recycling area directly below.

hunks.baseline: So did the well-built young man gazing at it.
hunks.sol: Then he noticed the burly young man standing there, staring at it.

hunks.baseline: The hunk of metal was the junk capsule Taekyung had picked up the day before. After pulling some failed prank with it, he seemed to be taking it back out to throw away.
hunks.sol: The hunk of metal was the junk capsule Taekyung had picked up the day before. After playing some ridiculous prank with it, he seemed to be throwing it out again.

hunks.baseline: *He’d been awfully serious for a prank like that… Ah, whatever. It was nonsense.*
hunks.sol: *He was awfully serious for a prank like that… Ah, whatever. It was nonsense.*

hunks.baseline: Seong Jinho gave a short laugh.
hunks.sol: Seong Jinho let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You believed that?”
hunks.sol: “You actually believed that?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung smiled back. But to Seong Jinho, who had watched him for a long time, the smile looked somehow awkward.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung smiled back. But to Seong Jinho, who had known him for a long time, the smile looked strangely awkward.

hunks.baseline: “That bastard’s really working hard…”
hunks.sol: “That bastard really works hard…”
